personality_one_liner: A sleek, command-center dashboard for digital CEOs, prioritizing operational clarity and financial intelligence with a premium, data-dense dark-mode aesthetic.

spacing.rule: Dense but clear. Use md (12px) between stacked metrics, and lg (16px) between major dashboard sections. Generous padding inside cards (lg) to let data breathe.

do's: Use heavy glassmorphism for the bottom tab bar to allow scrolling content to bleed through.
Use subtle glass for the hero AI Score floating card if it overlays the dark abstract texture.
Apply glass to sticky table headers when viewing long lists of portfolio assets.
dont's: Never blur standard metric cards or list items; keep data crisp on solid surfaceSecondary.
Avoid glass behind small text inputs.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: The ultimate CEO overview, combining high-level revenue metrics, AI opportunity scoring, and actionable insights.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner using brand color.
states.empty: N/A - dashboard populates with zero-state placeholders if no data.
states.error: Minimal text 'Unable to load telemetry' with a subtle retry icon.

screens.layout: Header: 'Overview' title with an elegant greeting. Hero Section: A large, rich AI Business Health Score visualization (progress ring or gauge) sitting on a subtle dark texture background. Underneath: A 2-column grid of essential metrics (Revenue, Profit, Followers, Growth) using Barlow Condensed for huge numbers. Below that: A horizontally scrolling list of AI Recommendation Cards (brandTertiary tinted, priority tagged).

screens.name: Portfolio Management
screens.purpose: Track health and profitability across all business assets (YouTube, IG, SaaS, Courses).

states.empty: Illustration of an empty folder. 'Connect your first platform.' with Primary CTA.
states.error: Error loading assets. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header for total portfolio value. Below: A stacked list of platforms. Each row contains: Left: Real PNG logo of the platform (YouTube, IG) in a subtle circular container. Middle: Asset name and AI Score. Right: Revenue and trend sparkline.

screens.name: Financial Intelligence
screens.purpose: Deep dive into cash flow, revenue trends, and forecasts.
screens.layout: Top half: A sleek, glowing line chart (using success/warning colors based on trend) against a pure black background. Segmented control to switch between 1W/1M/1Y. Bottom half: Split panel showing Cash Flow vs. Expenses, followed by recent high-value transactions.

screens.name: AI Consultant
screens.purpose: A chat-based AI coach for strategic decisions and content ideas.

states.empty: A greeting from the AI with 3 suggestion chips ('Analyze my growth', 'Draft Q3 strategy', 'Review latest video').
states.error: Network error. Reconnect to AI core.

screens.layout: Chat interface. AI messages in surfaceSecondary bubbles, User messages in brandTertiary bubbles. Input field sticky at bottom with a floating send button. Very Apple Messages but dark/fintech vibe.

hero_ai_score_bg.alt: Dark textured luxury background for AI score

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality: heavy use of dark obsidian, crisp borders (0.5pt), and data-dense but breathable layouts. Absolutely NO blue, purple, or indigo.

For the Hero AI Score on the Dashboard, use a beautiful, large metric display (Barlow Condensed font) layered over the 'hero_ai_score_bg' image. YOU MUST apply the vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface color) over the image so text stays readable.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Keep them outlined unless active in the tab bar.

For the portfolio list, use the provided YouTube/IG image URLs as avatars. Since they are photographic, apply a subtle border and clip them into circles (radius: pill). If image loading fails, fallback to standard text initials or vector icons.
Financial charts should be built with minimal gridlines. Rely on typography and glowing accent colors (success/error/brand) for data storytelling.
Implement the sticky primary CTA pattern where applicable (e.g., adding a new asset in Portfolio).
Keep typography weights at 400 or 500 maximum. Let the large sizes of Barlow Condensed create the visual hierarchy.
Tab bar must have glassmorphism applied so scrolling lists gently disappear behind it.
Every icon must be consistent in weight. Do not mix filled and outlined icons on the same screen (except tab active states).
